E-COP-013.what_happened: An admin tried to promote or demote the copilot. The copilot always stays a member; its reach is set by module grants and the tool gate, never by an admin role.
E-COP-013.likely_cause: The copilot looked like any other person on Manage users.
E-COP-013.fix_hint: Change the copilot's module access instead.

E-COP-014.user_message: Nothing was changed. Some of the keys in the bulk map change are not in this map.
E-COP-014.what_happened: The AI sent a bulk map change (scaffold) naming a stage or row key the map does not have. Every key is checked before anything is written, so the whole change was refused and the map is exactly as it was. The message names the missing keys.
E-COP-014.likely_cause: The AI used keys from an older view of the map, or guessed a key.
E-COP-014.fix_hint: Ask the AI to read the map again and resend the change with the keys it actually has.

E-COP-015.user_message: Nothing was changed. One step of the bulk map change could not be applied, so the whole change was undone.
E-COP-015.what_happened: A bulk map change (scaffold) failed part-way, for example removing a stage that live work depends on, or adding a row with an unknown actor type. Every step runs inside one transaction, so all earlier steps in the same call were rolled back too; the map is exactly as it was. The Health event names the failed step.
E-COP-015.likely_cause: A remove blocked by live work, or an invalid value in one operation.
E-COP-015.fix_hint: Fix or drop the step named in the message and send the change again.

E-COP-020.user_message: The copilot wants to do something that waits for your approval. Nothing was done yet.
E-COP-020.what_happened: A copilot action whose level is 'Waits for you' was stored as a waiting item in Approvals instead of being carried out. The copilot was told to say so.
E-COP-020.likely_cause: Expected: this kind of action waits for the owner.
E-COP-020.fix_hint: Open Approvals and approve, edit or reject the item.

E-COP-021.user_message: This item has already been decided.
E-COP-021.what_happened: A second Approve/Edit/Reject was refused by the once-only guard (a unique index), so nothing was decided twice.
E-COP-021.likely_cause: A double click, or the copilot repeating a call.
E-COP-021.fix_hint: Nothing to do; check the item's status in Approvals.

E-COP-022.user_message: This is out of date: the map changed after the copilot drafted it. Nothing was done; ask the copilot to draft it again.
E-COP-022.what_happened: On approval, the map the action targets had a newer write than when the item was drafted, so the item was marked rejected (out of date) instead of running on old information.
E-COP-022.likely_cause: Someone (or the copilot) changed the map while the item waited.
E-COP-022.fix_hint: Ask the copilot to draft it again from the current map.

E-COP-023.user_message: This kind of action is locked and its level can't be changed.
E-COP-023.what_happened: Someone tried to change the approval level of a locked or person-only action type (for example Publish version). Those levels are fixed by design.
E-COP-023.fix_hint: Nothing to do; locked types stay as they are.

E-COP-024.user_message: This item expired without an answer, so it was never carried out. The copilot can draft it again.
E-COP-024.what_happened: A waiting copilot action passed 72 hours without a decision and was marked expired. Silence never approves anything.
E-COP-024.likely_cause: The owner did not answer in time.
E-COP-024.fix_hint: Ask the copilot to draft it again if it is still wanted.

E-COP-025.user_message: Only a person can do this. It is ready for the owner to do themselves.
E-COP-025.what_happened: The copilot tried a person-only action (Publish version or Publish to live) and was refused at the gate. Nothing changed.
E-COP-025.likely_cause: These two actions always need a person (decision D-4).
E-COP-025.fix_hint: Open the map or plan and click Publish yourself when ready.

E-COP-026.user_message: This kind of action can't be undone once done. Confirm that the copilot may do it without asking you first.
E-COP-026.what_happened: A level change that would let the copilot do an irreversible, outside-reaching action without asking first was sent without the confirmation.
E-COP-026.fix_hint: Confirm the change on the Approval levels tab, or keep it at 'Waits for you'.

E-COP-027.user_message: The input does not match what the owner approved. Send exactly the approved input. Nothing was done.
E-COP-027.what_happened: The copilot tried to run an approved action with different content from what the owner approved, or an action that is not approved. The gate refused it and nothing ran.
E-COP-027.likely_cause: The copilot changed the content after approval, or reused an item that was rejected.
E-COP-027.fix_hint: Check the item in Approvals; ask the copilot to send exactly the approved version.

E-COP-028.user_message: Only a person can approve or reject the copilot's actions.
E-COP-028.what_happened: An AI identity tried to approve, edit or reject a copilot action. Only a signed-in person may decide.
E-COP-028.likely_cause: An AI calling a person-only endpoint.
E-COP-028.fix_hint: Nothing to do for the owner; decide the item yourself in Approvals.

E-COP-029.what_happened: The copilot action or business named does not exist in this account. Items in other accounts answer the same way.
E-COP-029.likely_cause: A wrong id, or an item from another account.

E-COP-030.user_message: That approved action has already been carried out.
E-COP-030.what_happened: The copilot called a tool again with an approval that had already been used. The once-only guard refused it, so the action did not run twice.

E-COP-031.user_message: Only a person can change approval levels.
E-COP-031.what_happened: An AI identity tried to change an approval level. Levels move only when a person moves them.
E-COP-031.likely_cause: An AI calling a person-only endpoint.
E-COP-031.fix_hint: Change levels yourself on the Approval levels tab.

E-COP-032.what_happened: A decision other than approve, edit or reject was sent.
E-COP-032.likely_cause: A screen or script sent a bad value.
E-COP-032.fix_hint: Use the buttons on the Approvals screen.

E-COP-033.user_message: Add your edited version before sending it.
E-COP-033.what_happened: Edit was chosen but no edited content was sent.
E-COP-033.likely_cause: The edit box was empty or not valid JSON.
E-COP-033.fix_hint: Fill in the edited version, then send.

E-COP-034.user_message: Choose runs on its own, runs then tells you, or waits for you, and a limit of 0 or more.
E-COP-034.what_happened: A level change named a level that does not exist, or a negative limit.
E-COP-034.likely_cause: A screen or script sent a bad value.
E-COP-034.fix_hint: Pick one of the three levels and a limit of 0 or more.

E-COP-035.what_happened: The business named for the approval levels does not exist in this account. Businesses in other accounts answer the same way.

E-COP-036.user_message: That approval was not found for this tool. Nothing was done.
E-COP-036.what_happened: The copilot passed an approval number that does not exist, belongs to another account, or was for a different tool.
E-COP-036.likely_cause: The copilot used a wrong approval number.
E-COP-036.fix_hint: Check Approvals for the right item.

E-COP-038.user_message: That belongs to another business. This conversation works on one business only; switch business to work on it.
E-COP-038.what_happened: The copilot, working in a conversation pinned to one business, tried to read or change a map or business outside it. The gate refused it and nothing happened.
E-COP-038.likely_cause: The question touched another business, or the copilot guessed an id.
E-COP-038.fix_hint: Switch the copilot to the other business and ask again.

E-COP-039.user_message: Pick a business first. Maps outside any business always use the safe defaults.
E-COP-039.what_happened: Someone tried to set an approval level for 'maps outside any business'. Those always use the safe defaults; levels are set per business.
E-COP-039.likely_cause: The levels screen was on 'Maps outside any business'.
E-COP-039.fix_hint: Choose a business in the picker, then change its levels.

E-COP-037.user_message: This conversation works inside one business, so it can't create a new one. Ask a person to create it.
E-COP-037.what_happened: The copilot, in a conversation pinned to one business, tried to create a new business. That is refused; new businesses are made by a person.
E-COP-037.likely_cause: The owner asked the copilot to start a new business from inside another one.
E-COP-037.fix_hint: Create the new business yourself, then talk to the copilot about it.

E-COP-040.user_message: Your account doesn't have a copilot yet. An admin can create one on Manage users.
E-COP-040.what_happened: Someone opened the copilot or set up its home, but the account has no copilot identity.
E-COP-040.likely_cause: No copilot has been created for this account.
E-COP-040.fix_hint: An account admin creates the copilot on Manage users.

E-COP-041.user_message: The copilot is switched off. An admin can switch it back on in Manage users.
E-COP-041.what_happened: Someone sent the copilot a message while it is switched off. Nothing ran.
E-COP-041.likely_cause: An admin switched the copilot off.
E-COP-041.fix_hint: Switch the copilot back on in Manage users.

E-COP-042.user_message: That conversation belongs to another business. Pick it from that business, or start a new one here.
E-COP-042.what_happened: A copilot conversation was opened or continued under a different business (or account) than the one it was started for. A conversation's business never changes.
E-COP-042.likely_cause: The business picker changed but an old conversation id was reused.
E-COP-042.fix_hint: Start a new conversation for this business.

E-COP-043.user_message: Type a message for the copilot.
E-COP-043.what_happened: An empty message was sent to the copilot.
E-COP-043.likely_cause: Send was pressed with an empty box.

E-COP-044.user_message: The copilot already has its own business.
E-COP-044.what_happened: Someone tried to set up the copilot's own 'how I work' business a second time. There is one per account.

E-COP-045.user_message: This only works in a copilot conversation about one business.
E-COP-045.what_happened: A copilot tool that works inside one business (goals, notes, research, business memory) was called outside a one-business conversation.
E-COP-045.likely_cause: The tool was called from another chat or without a business.
E-COP-045.fix_hint: Use it from the copilot panel with a business picked.

E-COP-046.user_message: kind is insight or runnable; made_by is copilot_research, copilot_strategy or copilot_draft.
E-COP-046.what_happened: A map label was set with a value that isn't allowed. The copilot can never mark a map tested.
E-COP-046.fix_hint: Use one of the allowed values.

E-COP-047.user_message: Research returned nothing usable this time. Nothing was drafted.
E-COP-047.what_happened: The copilot's research step finished without a usable result, so no maps were drafted.
E-COP-047.likely_cause: Search found little, or the research step failed.
E-COP-047.fix_hint: Ask the copilot to try a more specific topic, or try again later.

E-COP-048.user_message: The copilot only works inside a conversation about one business.
E-COP-048.what_happened: A tool call arrived as the copilot without a business pin (for example a ticket from another chat). It was refused so the copilot can never work across businesses.
E-COP-048.likely_cause: A ticket was reused outside the copilot chat.
E-COP-048.fix_hint: Use the copilot from its panel with a business picked.

E-COP-049.user_message: A note is one short line (up to 500 characters).
E-COP-049.what_happened: A copilot note was empty or too long.
E-COP-049.likely_cause: Too much text in one note.
E-COP-049.fix_hint: Keep each note to one short line.

E-COP-050.what_happened: A goal's status was set to a value that isn't allowed.
E-COP-050.likely_cause: A screen or script sent a bad value.
E-COP-050.fix_hint: Use the buttons on the goals list.

E-COP-051.user_message: Research can only change maps the copilot made. Make a new draft map instead.
E-COP-051.what_happened: A copilot research run tried to change a map that a person made.
E-COP-051.likely_cause: The research step tried to reuse an existing map, or a web page told it to.
E-COP-051.fix_hint: Nothing to fix: the map was not changed. Ask the copilot in chat if you do want that map edited.

E-COP-052.user_message: Search generally: no business or customer names, contact details or long numbers. Reword the search.
E-COP-052.what_happened: A copilot research search was refused before it was sent, because it held something private.
E-COP-052.likely_cause: The search text contained an email address, a long number, this business's name or the run ticket.
E-COP-052.fix_hint: Nothing to fix: nothing left Emgram. If research keeps failing on an ordinary topic, tell the engineer which topic.

E-COP-053.user_message: Sources are a short list: up to 20, each a title (up to 200 characters) and a link (up to 500).
E-COP-053.what_happened: A map label was given too many sources, or a source that was too long.
E-COP-053.likely_cause: The copilot tried to store page text as a source.
E-COP-053.fix_hint: Nothing to fix: the label was not changed.

E-COP-054.user_message: That task isn't assigned to you on a published day, so you can't record work on it.
E-COP-054.what_happened: The copilot tried to record work on a task that is not its own.
E-COP-054.likely_cause: The task belongs to a person, is not scheduled, or its day has not been published to live.
E-COP-054.fix_hint: Nothing to fix: nothing was recorded. To give the copilot the task, assign it on the plan and publish the day.

E-COP-055.user_message: That day is already live. Only the owner changes a live day - tell them what you would change.
E-COP-055.what_happened: The copilot tried to change a day that has been published to live.
E-COP-055.likely_cause: The day was published after the copilot started drafting, or it picked a live day.
E-COP-055.fix_hint: Nothing to fix: the live day was not changed. Make the change yourself on the board if you want it.

E-COP-056.user_message: The previous run for this business is still going, so this one was skipped.
E-COP-056.what_happened: A scheduled copilot run started while the one before it had not finished.
E-COP-056.likely_cause: The earlier run is taking longer than an hour, or a run was started by hand at the same time.
E-COP-056.fix_hint: Nothing to fix: the copilot did not do the same work twice. If runs keep being skipped, look at the run that is still going - after 30 minutes it is marked as failed.

E-COP-057.user_message: The copilot did not finish its scheduled run. Anything it did before stopping is in the activity log.
E-COP-057.what_happened: A scheduled copilot run could not start, stopped without an answer, or did not finish within 30 minutes.
E-COP-057.likely_cause: The AI service did not answer or took too long, or the run ran out of steps.
E-COP-057.fix_hint: Open the run under Scheduled runs in the copilot panel to see what it held and did. The next hourly run tries again. If it keeps failing, check the AI service key and the copilot's daily cap.
